policy.unit_of_observation: One row represents one metric from one benchmark split and one named system configuration. Never combine metrics from different configurations into a synthetic system.
policy.comparison_ceiling: All included external scores are contextual or historical references unless a separately preregistered matched comparison is recorded; no direct CEB superiority claim is supported by this registry.
policy.uncertainty_rule: Preserve source-reported uncertainty notation. Do not infer a confidence level or interval method unless the source states it.
policy.denominator_rule: Every task or pair count belongs to its exact benchmark/split. Missing denominators must be explicitly marked not_reported, not silently imputed. Candidate-dependent augmented-recall denominators are per-agent discovery diagnostics and must not be used as a common cross-agent ranking denominator.
policy.unlabeled_rule: An unlabeled leaderboard value remains unlabeled; it cannot be mapped to a named metric by guesswork.
